correctness.rationale: Exact attainable maximal horizontal slices are justified by translation 0 in B and nesting. Fubini yields two integrals; Minkowski polynomial expansion and the combinatorial identity d*C(d-1,k)/(d-k)=C(d,k) prove adjacent coefficients. Brunn–Minkowski and its equality theorem establish the sharp lower bound; classical Rogers–Shephard proves sharp upper at s=1; continuity of Minkowski interpolation gives full range. Rational polygon geometry and independent SciPy convex-hull comparisons for arbitrary oblique apices and unbalanced s values passed. No finite computations are used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural dimension-raising operation on arbitrary convex bases is shown to preserve a complete, explicit mixed-volume signature through adjacent sums. This supplies a new structural link between dimensions, a sharp unbalanced lower envelope with rigidity, a complete normalized interval, and the exact 3D profile determined by one planar difference-area ratio. These questions are motivated by canonical Rogers–Shephard and Godbersen geometry rather than arbitrary numerical specialization.
